description: This file defines the interface {@code JsonFieldDefinition} which describes the schema of a JSON field, including methods for creating field definitions for various data types, retrieving metadata such as pointers and markers, and mapping JSON values to Java types. It also includes detailed documentation and examples demonstrating how to describe JSON document structures and fields within a schema.

methods.name: ofString
methods.description: Creates a new JSON field definition for a String value with an optional set of markers, wrapping {@link JsonFactory#newStringFieldDefinition}.

methods.name: ofInt
methods.description: Creates a new JSON field definition for an int value with optional markers.

methods.name: ofLong
methods.description: Creates a new JSON field definition for a long value with optional markers.

methods.name: ofDouble
methods.description: Creates a new JSON field definition for a double value with optional markers.

methods.name: ofBoolean
methods.description: Creates a new JSON field definition for a boolean value with optional markers.

methods.name: ofJsonObject
methods.description: Creates a new JSON field definition for a JsonObject value with optional markers.

methods.name: ofJsonArray
methods.description: Creates a new JSON field definition for a JsonArray value with optional markers.

methods.name: ofJsonValue
methods.description: Creates a new JSON field definition for a JsonValue (generic JSON value) with optional markers.

methods.name: getPointer
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer string that refers to this field definition.

methods.name: getValueType
methods.description: Returns the Class object representing the Java type of the value for this field definition.

methods.name: getMarkers
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable set of markers associated with this field definition.

methods.name: isMarkedAs
methods.description: Checks whether this field definition is marked with at least all of the specified markers.

methods.name: mapValue
methods.description: Converts a JsonValue to the Java type associated with this field definition, throwing an exception if invalid.
